title: The Ballad of Radolf
description: StoryAfter years of peace an island emerges from the sea with the Demon race, now the Demon race threatens to throw the world into chaos. Can you stop the Demon race and restore peace to the world.Choose your own pathI've taken a non-linear approach allowing you to choose your own path in how you want to proceed.GameplayA turn based RPG where you sail between islands to defeat the Demon King's forces.Multiple endingsYour ending will change depending on how many bosses you beat before facing the final boss.
description_short: After years of peace an island emerges from the sea with the Demon race, now the Demon race threatens to throw the world into chaos. Can you stop the Demon race and restore peace to the world in this turn based RPG.
